text:
Zoe: FYI — saw multiple tenants suddenly routed to v2 yesterday evening even though they use older SDKs that don't set `x-redwood-api-version`.
Zoe: spike in token-cost per-tenant, console flagged by anomaly detector around 19:03.
Marco: are we still defaulting to latest when header absent? thought we changed to prefer-stable last quarter.
Aisha: runtime has layered rules: header -> explicit. else: routing-decider consults `tenant_affinity` then `capacity_preference`. capacity_preference was toggled to prefer-new yesterday for capacity smoothing.
Zoe: so combination of prefer-new + missing header = surprise upgrades. small tenants got charged for bigger models.
ops-bot: suggested immediate action: set `unknown_version_fallback=stable` in canary for 5m test.
Marco: +1 for immediate rollback. also we should emit a lightweight metric: `tokens.by_declared_vs_routed` to surface mismatch counts.
Aisha: I'll add a counter label (declared, routed) with seqlen bucket; low cost to emit.
Zoe: would like a lightweight response header too so customers can see server decision: `X-Redwood-Fallback: inferred=v2` or `declared=v1`. low risk.
Marco: also propose a short-term safety guard: per-tenant soft cap on tokens routed to higher-cost variants when declared_version is missing (default 75k/hr). Billing & ops to tune.
Billing: 75k/hr seems reasonable as a starting throttle; we can auto-exempt verified enterprise tenants. we'll draft credit policy for unexpected overages.
Aisha: for telemetry naming I suggest `version_inference_event` and a tiny reason enum: `hist_affinity`, `capacity_bias`, `prompt_margin`. keeps downstream queries easier.
Zoe: UI work: add a per-route toggle in console to "Prefer stable for unknown-version" and a chart that breaks down tokens by (declared vs inferred). Marco can you sketch?
Marco: yep — I'll put a quick mock in Figma and link to PLAT-7011.
ops-bot: rolling canary change: `unknown_version_fallback=stable` applied. monitor 15m.
Zoe: early numbers: canary shows ~50% reduction in tokens for affected tenants. good sign.
Aisha: started emitting `version_inference_event` to the metrics stream; first samples visible in 6m.
Billing: we'll prepare an outreach template and propose a one-day automatic bill-smoothing for tenants hit by inferred upgrades; posting draft to #customer-comms.
Marco: long-term: we need RFC that defines default semantics for absent version header, devex SDKs should set header, console affordances, and opt-in flags per-tenant. I'll draft RFC with decision matrix.
Zoe: owners: rollback & monitor — Marco; telemetry event + stream hookup — Aisha; console mock + ticket — Marco; billing template & safeguards — Billing + Zoe.
Aisha: small follow-up: recommend we make the router log decision_reason at debug level so SREs can triage without heavy payloads.
Zoe: agreed. tagging PLAT-7011 and INF-5202. I'll keep thread pinned for 48h. Thanks team.
